lines.text: Halt Junction, a quarter to midnight. Weeds between the rails. One lamp still lit.
You'll be the odd-jobs people. Mind the signals. They've started giving opinions.
This one has fogged its own lamp and shuffled the timetable. And the inspector is writing fines with numbers on them that are not numbers.
Something's moving in the coal yard, too.
That is Gerald. Gerald used to be the coal.
